full_prompt_en: The image is a square sepia-toned black-and-white photograph of two people seated close together at a table. On the left, a woman in a pale high-necked blouse leans slightly forward, resting her folded arms near the tabletop. The blouse has prominent puffed shoulders, lace or ruffled detail around the neck, and soft gathered fabric at the sleeves. A broad dark hat frames her face; a light floral ornament sits along its upper edge. She looks directly toward the camera with a composed expression. On the right, a man in a dark striped suit and vest leans toward her. His broad-brimmed hat tilts over his forehead, and a pale shirt and loosely arranged neckwear brighten the center of his dark clothing. He also meets the camera, with a faint relaxed smile. Their faces sit close together near the upper middle of the frame, creating an intimate shared focus. The table occupies the lower foreground as a soft dark horizontal band. Behind them, the interior falls into blurred shadow. A few small bright lamp shapes and indistinct figures or furnishings appear, but none is sharply defined. The picture has aged photographic grain and slightly softened edges, especially in the background. Pale fabric and illuminated faces contrast with the man's suit, both hats, and the deep room behind. Light appears to come from the front left, modeling cheeks and the folds of the blouse without hard dramatic shadow. The pose is deliberate yet warm, with the two bodies angled inward and the gaze shared with the viewer. The composition is tightly cropped so the couple, their hats, and contrasting clothes fill most of the frame. Its visual character comes from the rich sepia grayscale, textured print surface, dignified dress, and close, human presence rather than any modern high-gloss finish.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带棕褐色调的黑白照片，两人紧挨着坐在桌边。左侧女子穿浅色高领上衣，微微前倾，交叠的手臂靠近桌面。上衣有突出的蓬袖、领口的蕾丝或褶饰以及袖上的柔软收褶。一顶宽大深帽框住她的脸，帽子上缘有浅色花饰。她以端庄的神情直视镜头。右侧男子身着深色条纹西服和背心，身体向她倾斜。宽檐帽斜压额头，浅色衬衫与松系的领饰照亮深色衣服中央。他也望向镜头，带一丝放松的笑意。两张脸在画面上部中央靠近，形成亲密的共同焦点。桌面作为柔软的深色横带占据下方前景。身后室内退入模糊暗影。几处小而明亮的灯形和难辨的人影或家具隐约可见，却都不清晰。照片有陈旧胶片颗粒与轻微柔化的边缘，尤其在背景中明显。浅色布料和受光的脸与男子西服、两顶帽子及身后幽暗空间对照。光似从左前方而来，塑造脸颊和上衣褶皱，却没有硬而夸张的投影。姿势经过安排但温暖，两人身体内倾，共同与观者对视。构图收得很紧，让两人、帽子与对比鲜明的衣服充满画幅。其视觉性格来自浓郁的棕褐灰阶、有肌理的相纸、端庄着装与亲近的人物存在，而非现代高光泽处理。
style_prompt_en: Aged monochrome photography uses warm sepia grays, soft print grain, and gently blurred peripheral detail. Light-colored fabric and illuminated skin create broad pale passages against near-black garments and a dark room. The camera stays close enough for expressions and fabric shapes to dominate, while the background remains suggestive rather than descriptive. Light from the front and one side gives faces mild modeling without sharp theatrical contrast. Broad hats, curved shoulders, and overlapping silhouettes produce a compact rhythm of dark and light masses. The print retains slight tonal unevenness and an archival softness. The atmosphere is intimate and dignified, with human proximity, restrained pose, and tactile photographic surface carrying the visual effect.
style_prompt_zh: 陈旧的单色摄影运用暖棕褐灰阶、柔软相纸颗粒和轻微模糊的外围细节。浅色布料与受光皮肤在近黑服装和暗室中形成大片亮区。镜头距离较近，神情与布料形状占主导，背景只作暗示而不详细说明。前方略偏侧的光让脸部温和起伏，没有尖锐的戏剧反差。宽檐、弧形肩线与重叠剪影形成紧凑的深浅节奏。相纸保留些许调子不均与档案照片般的柔化。氛围亲密而端庄，由人物之间的靠近、克制姿势和可触的摄影表面形成效果。
theme_en: A seated couple in formal vintage clothing and wide-brimmed hats
theme_zh: 一对身穿复古正装、戴宽檐帽的人并肩而坐
name: James Van Der Zee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
